text: {"differences": [{"reason": "English text states the section handles \"more than 2,500\" business items, while German text states \"rund 2500\" (around 2500).", "type": "meaning_shift", "en": {"quote": "more than 2,500 items of business", "before": "Each year it handles"}, "tgt": {"quote": "rund 2500 Geschäfte", "before": "Die betreut die rund"}, "severity": 0.4}, {"reason": "English text mentions the section \"draws up the agenda, runs the joint reports procedure and issues the decisions made by the Federal Council\", which is omitted in the German text.", "type": "omission", "en": {"quote": "It plans the Federal Council meetings, draws up the agenda, runs the joint reports procedure and issues the decisions made by the Federal Council.", "before": ""}, "tgt": null, "severity": 0.6}, {"reason": "German text adds that the section \"also manages around 1300 parliamentary motions annually and organizes their response\", which is not present in the English text.", "type": "addition", "en": null, "tgt": {"quote": "Sie verwaltet auch die jährlich rund 1300 parlamentarischen Vorstösse und organisiert deren Beantwortung.", "before": "Die betreut die rund 2500 Geschäfte, welche die Departemente und die BK dem Bundesrat jährlich zur Verabschiedung unterbreiten."}, "severity": 0.6}]}
